record.question: Which of the following regulatory body can grant 'Emergency use Authorization' EUA to a drug?
record.explanation: Answer C: Central Drug Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO). CDSCO/DCGI is India’s central drug regulator responsible for authorizing drugs, including restricted/emergency use permissions under applicable rules. Source/context note: The phrase “EUA” is not a single uniform Indian statutory pathway; authorization depends on the applicable law and context. Reference: https://cdsco.gov.in/opencms/opencms/en/Home/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
